citations.F1: N+1 user queries: serialize_event independently fetches one user per event (~1000 round-trips) → batch into one query.
citations.F2: O(n²) dedupe: checking `in seen` on a list for 1.9k events → use set.
citations.F3: Blocking geo lookups: requests.get() in async handler stalls event loop, breaks /healthz → use async httpx.AsyncClient.
citations.F4: Missing DB index: query does full table scan of 4.2M rows for ~1.9k result → create (org_id, created_at DESC) index.
citations.F6: Unbounded geo_cache: no eviction, grows to 2.1GB in 20h → add LRU or size-limit eviction.
citations.F9: No: proposal doesn't fix root causes (N+1 queries, blocking I/O, missing index, unbounded memory); spend resources on fixes 1–10 instead.
